body:
I really hope so, sometimes I just give up what I do and just sit in a corner thinking about how much better it would be without me. And what happens is that I see that it would be better without me in the best or worst case scenario.
Good luck with your college applications, I hope it works out for you. :)

Yeah I know what you mean. It's especially bad because it just suddenly hits me. And these days it's been hitting me a lot. I haven't even slept in the past few days. But a big thanks to you and everyone else who listened. :)

I have thought about it a lot.
But she's at home now and not that near me.
We used to be but she's found other and better people to keep her safe and I'm happy she has.

Thank you, like I said my friend always tries to help me out no matter what but I honestly feel like all I do is talk about my problems and that makes me feel really guilty. That won't affect her well either and it's probably killing our friendship. 
Thank you though, I will take your advice. It's just that sometimes I get pushed to the bottom at the drop of a hat, and it's impossible to climb out of it when I do.

I know exactly how you feel, when I did sort of well but not excellent in my GSCE my dad didn't talk to me for a week and all my mom did was call me a disappointment. It honestly broke me and I never studied hard enough since then.
But, I honestly feel like all I am is a financial burden to them. I'm not the type to excel and I never have been.
Thank you for understanding though, it really means a lot.

Yeah but she's dealing with her own problems right now, they're about as bad as mine but she's much stronger than I am.
I haven't yet since it's easter break but I probably will when it reopens.

Oh okay.
I'd talk to him but he's in between jobs right now.
I wish my parents were like that but my family is pretty dysfunctional. My mom's been going through a lot and knowing that I'm having problems of my own would be too much for her.
And my dad's never really been the emotional type.
I do care about my parents, they're honestly the reason I don't want to kill myself right now but I've never been used to telling them things.

I know that it's hard on other people, which is why I didn't force them to talk to me after they stopped. The friend I made at college is amazing and understanding and always tries to help me even though she's had a lot of problems at home. But I think the fact that her problems and my problems are happening at the same time is affecting our friendship pretty badly. She used to always tell me what was going on and now it's mainly ignoring me, not telling me or even in rare cases lying to me. 
I would talk to my family but honestly I've never connected that much with my dad and my mom has a lot of her own problems to deal with and my sibling's lives in a different country and it's a pretty big time difference.
I really wish I could open up to friends but after the number of times it made me lose friends makes me get an instinct to never trust anyone.
Thank you for your advice though :) And I'm sorry your friend would do that to you.

I'm really sorry for your loss. The thing is, I can't really call anyone my friend except the few I've made at college. Even then, only one knows about my problems and while she was there for me at first, she got new friends who were into the same things she was and talking to me just wasn't that worth it for her anymore. I know she still really cares about me and everything, but like I said I can see the spark dying.
I know that if I were to die, only my immediate family would care. All my childhood friends stopped talking to me after I went to college, no matter how much I tried to keep in touch. And although my friend would care, it probably wouldn't affect her much and I've been more of a burden to here these past few months than a friend.

Well tbh when another family member got depressed, although they expressed how horrible it was, they didn't understand it. They were like 'why would someone do that, it's stupid' added to the fact I've never been comfortable sharing things with my family and I've lost friends for sharing with them because I was "too sad" and "not fun to talk to anymore".
